items.whatsNew:
## What's New in v0.6.8-1

### iOS 27 Theme Polish & Layout Fixes
- **`•••` Liquid Glass Quick Menu:** Extra home toolbar action icons (such as ghost mode, restart, trash, and seen toggles) now automatically tuck into the left `•••` **Liquid Glass** dropdown menu alongside WhatsApp's native overflow menu (*More Options*), leaving only the frosted camera and green `+` button on the top right.
- **R8-Safe Green `+` Alignment:** Replaced obfuscation-sensitive toolbar gravity reflection with direct layout positioning so the circular green new-chat button stays cleanly pinned to the right edge.
- **Status & Search Bar Spacing:** Fixed an overlap where the 2nd-tier large header (*Chats / Updates / Calls*) clipped the top of circular status cards (`IGStatus`) and crowded the search bar.
- **Archive Gesture & Duplicate Icon Guard:** Connected the hidden archive multi-tap / long-press shortcut directly to the large header title and automatically paused the legacy `New Chat` toolbar icon when the iOS 27 header is active.

### Build Scripts & Documentation
- **Upstream Sync & Rebrand Hardening:** Updated `rebrand.sh` to properly parse hyphenated version strings (`0.6.8-1`) and preserve all custom Compose activities (`ThemesActivity`, `ManualColorsActivity`, `MaterialExpressiveActivity`, `ElasticMessagesActivity`, `FloatingBarActivity`, `AppearanceActivity`) in `AndroidManifest.xml`, alongside safer merge protection in `wpmerge.sh`.
- **README Refresh:** Updated `README.md` with the WhatsPosed logo, UI screenshots, compatibility matrix, and honest platform notes.
-

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.8
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.8

### Unified Themes Center & Conflict-Free Architecture
Introduced a centralized **Themes** hub (*Customization > Themes*) powered by `ThemeCoordinator` so full UI theme packs can switch cleanly without clashing with legacy overrides:

- **Exclusive Theme Switching:** Switch seamlessly between **iOS 27 (Liquid Glass)**, **Material 3 Expressive**, and **Default (Stock WhatsApp)**.
- **Automatic Conflict Guards:** Selecting **iOS 27** automatically suspends Monet/manual color overrides, custom home toolbar titles, and manual bubble overrides at the hook level—restoring your settings when switching back—while relocating manual color, Monet, and bubble controls into a dedicated **Manual Colors, Monet & Bubbles** screen.
- **Signature Theme Docks:** Each theme automatically applies its matching floating dock (**Liquid Glass** for iOS 27, **Material You Pill** for Material 3 Expressive) while leaving dock presets and geometry freely customizable afterward.

---

### iOS 27 (Liquid Glass) Theme Pack
Added a full iOS 27 visual overhaul with fine-grained toggles inside the Themes screen:

- **2-Tier iOS Home Header & Liquid Glass `•••` Menu:** Features a frosted circular `•••` pill on the left, frosted camera and bright green `+` new-chat button on the right, and a bold dynamic 2nd-tier header (*Chats / Updates / Calls*) with support for the hidden archive tap/long-press gesture.
- **Smart Toolbar Decluttering:** Extra home toolbar action icons (such as restart, ghost mode, clear/trash, and seen toggles) automatically tuck into the `•••` **Liquid Glass** dropdown menu alongside WhatsApp's native overflow menu.
- **Bundled SF Pro Typography:** Embedded SF Pro Display (`Regular`, `Medium`, `Semibold`, `Bold`) directly into the module for authentic iOS typography across WhatsApp.
- **OLED Canvas, Liquid Glass Overlays & iOS Bubbles:** Pure `#000000` OLED dark / crisp white light surfaces, frosted search pill, native iOS-styled chat bubbles, Liquid Glass reaction trays, menus, bottom sheets, dialogs (with Android 12+ background blur), glass scroll-to-bottom pill, and InsetGrouped contact/settings cards.

---

### Material You Pill Dock Preset
- Added the **Material You Pill** preset to the Floating Bottom Bar editor, featuring a dynamic Monet capsule with a full-height active indicator pill wrapping both the tab icon and label, plus clean Liquid Glass chat handoff when switching themes.
-

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.7
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.7

### Semantic Release Update Checker
Rebuilt the update detection system across both the WhatsPosed app and the WhatsApp home screen popup:

- **Plain Tag Support:** Switched from legacy commit-hash parsing to full semantic version comparison, natively supporting clean release tags (e.g., `0.6.6`, `0.6.7`) while ignoring draft and pre-release builds.
- **WhatsApp Home Screen Update Popup:** Automatically notifies you on the WhatsApp home screen when a newer WhatsPosed release is published, displaying the new and installed versions, release date, formatted Markdown changelog, and **Update Now** / **Ignore** actions.
- **Rate-Limit Caching & HMA Resilience:** Added a 10-minute in-memory API cache with proper GitHub API headers, duplicate-popup debounce protection, and a `BuildConfig.VERSION_NAME` fallback when package visibility is restricted (e.g., Hide My Applist).
- **Detailed Update Diagnostics:** Added structured logging to LSPosed logs and Logcat (`WhatsPosedUpdate`) covering API responses, version comparisons, and popup triggers.

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.6
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.6

### Liquid Glass Chat UI
Added a modern floating glass chat interface under **Customization > Conversation > Liquid Glass chat UI**:

- **Separated Floating Islands:** Replaces flat top and bottom panels with sleek, separated liquid-glass islands — a compact back/avatar pill, a roomy contact header pill, a right action menu pill, a floating glass message composer capsule, and a detached circular mic/send button.
- **Real-Time Backdrop Refraction:** Floats the conversation list and wallpaper cleanly underneath both the header and composer so scrolling messages refract live through the glass using an **Android 13+ AGSL RuntimeShader** (edge light bending, subtle chromatic dispersion, and specular highlights), with a smooth frosted-glass fallback on older Android versions.
- **Material Expressive Compatible:** Automatically coordinates with Material Expressive so chat headers and composers remain crisp and unobstructed.

### Elastic Message Stretch & Dedicated Editor
Added fluid, physics-based message interaction under **Customization > Conversation > Elastic message stretch**:

- **Gel-Like Spring Physics:** Hold and drag any message bubble to stretch it smoothly toward your finger with volume-preserving squash-and-stretch and 3D perspective tilt, then release for a lively bouncy rebound — while keeping native swipe-to-reply, scrolling, and long-press reactions intact.
- **Dedicated Editor with Live Preview:** Organized into a single clean preference entry that opens a custom Compose editor featuring **interactive preview bubbles** you can drag and bounce in real time, quick presets (**Soft**, **Jelly**, **Bouncy**), sliders for **Stretch distance**, **Bounce intensity**, **Jelly squash & stretch**, **3D tilt & rotation**, and **Hold delay**, plus a haptic feedback toggle and one-tap reset.

### Chat Video Player Tools
Added enhanced gesture and speed controls for in-chat videos under **Media > Video > Chat video player tools**:

- **Double-Tap Seeking:** Double-tap the left or right side of a video to skip **-10s / +10s** with an on-screen indicator.
- **Playback Speed Pill:** Switch speeds on the fly (`1x`, `1.25x`, `1.5x`, `2x`, `2.5x`, `0.5x`) via a floating glass speed pill hooked directly into WhatsApp's Hero player.
- **Edge Swipe Controls:** Swipe vertically along the left edge to adjust **screen brightness** and along the right edge to adjust **media volume** with a live progress indicator.
-

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.5
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.5

### Status Playback Controls
Added a floating, vertically draggable control pill for status viewing under **General > Status > Status playback controls**:

- **Clean Fullscreen Toggle:** Hide all status chrome (progress bars, header, captions, and reply/reaction bar) with a single tap for distraction-free viewing, and restore everything cleanly on tap again.
- **Video Playback Controls:** Directly hooks WhatsApp's `WaFbHeroPlayer` and underlying `HeroPlayer` to support **-5s / +5s seeking**, **instant pause/resume**, and **playback speed switching** (`1x`, `1.5x`, `2x`, `0.5x`), automatically resetting to `1x` on new video statuses.

### Chat Floating Tools Upgraded to 3×2
Expanded the floating chat tools menu with two new tools matching the Material Expressive / Monet dialog style:

- **Text Styles (Unicode & WA Formatting):** Automatically pulls your current draft from the message box and live-previews styles including **Bold**, **Italic**, **Bold Italic**, **Monospace**, **Small Caps**, **Spaced**, **Bubbles**, **Upside Down**, **Bold Quote**, **Code Block**, and **Strikethrough** — insert or send in one tap.
- **Spoiler & Blank Messages:**
  - **Read More Spoiler:** Create collapsible teaser + hidden text messages using `U+3164` filler (includes a note that WhatsPosed's *"Remove Read More"* option may prevent collapsing locally).
  - **Blank Message:** Send short, medium, or tall invisible messages using `U+FFA0` (Halfwidth Hangul Filler) without triggering WhatsApp's empty-message check.
  -

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.4
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.4

### Liquid Glass Dock Preset (iOS 26 Style)
Added a new **Liquid Glass** style preset under **Customization > Home Screen > Floating Bottom Bar > Style Preset**:

- **Real-Time AGSL Glass Refraction (Android 13+):** Uses hardware-accelerated `RuntimeShader` for live edge refraction, subtle chromatic dispersion, and specular glass rim highlights (with automatic frosted glass fallback on older Android versions).
- **Interactive Magnifying Lens & Fluid Physics:** Press and hold or swipe horizontally across the dock to reveal a magnifying liquid lens that refracts the tabs underneath in real time, stretches with velocity-reactive jelly/spring physics, gives subtle haptic feedback across tabs, and snaps smoothly to switch pages on release.
- **Scroll-Hide Anchoring:** The liquid lens stays cleanly synchronized with the dock when hiding or revealing on scroll.

### Material Expressive UI Engine (Android 16 QPR2)
Introduced a dedicated, modular **Material Expressive** editor with a live preview card under **Customization > General > Material Expressive**:

- **Presets & Dynamic Monet Control:** Choose between `QPR2`, `Subtle`, and `Full Monet` presets, switch color sources (`Monet`, `Neutral`, `Custom`), dial in Monet intensity (`0–100%`), and sync directly with the built-in Monet color engine without conflicts.
- **Customizable Card Geometry:** Switch between `Segmented`, `Rounded`, and `Soft` card styles with adjustable outer corner radius (`10–30dp`), card spacing (`0–8dp`), optional subtle tonal outlines, and flat divider removal.
- **Modular Surface Toggles:** Independently enable or disable Expressive styling for chat list cards, settings and info panels, seamless top toolbar and single-pill search bar, chat composer bar (without touching wallpapers), expressive squircle FABs, dialogs/bottom sheets, and automatic Monet palette syncing for the **Chat Tools Bubble**.

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.2
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.2

Expanded the **Chat Tools Bubble** into a 2x2 Material 3 Expressive tool panel with three new utilities:

- **Text Repeater:** Repeat text or emojis into a single message with selectable separators (new line, space, or none). Supports inserting into the input box or sending immediately, with a 60,000-character safety limit.
- **Snippets:** Save frequently used messages and templates persistently with optional titles. Tap any snippet to insert it into the chat input, send it instantly with one tap, or remove it anytime.
- **Timer Send:** Schedule a message with quick presets (`10s`, `30s`, `60s`, `5m`) or a custom countdown in seconds. Displays a live amber countdown badge on the floating bubble with one-tap cancellation.
- **Draft Auto-Fill:** Message Bomber, Text Repeater, Snippets, and Timer Send now automatically pull any existing draft text from the chat input box.

releases.name: WhatsPosed v0.6.1
releases.notes:
## What's New in v0.6.1

- **Chat Tools Bubble:** Added a draggable floating bubble in chats (`Customization > Conversation > Chat Tools Bubble`) that snaps to screen edges and morphs into a Material 3 Expressive tool panel.
- **Message Bomber:** Send repeated messages with custom count and delay (ms), complete with a live countdown badge and one-tap stop.
- **Adaptive UI:** Automatically matches WhatsApp's Light/Dark theme and app language.

releases.name: v0.4.0 - First public release
releases.notes:
### Pill customization
- Color: stock, custom, or Monet (5 palettes, 13 tones), plus opacity (0% hides the pill)
- Gradient: two-color or rainbow
- Shapes: bar, dot, three dots
- Size and position: width, height, corner radius, vertical offset, horizontal alignment
- Outline with adjustable thickness and color
- Animation: breathe or flow, with speed control
- 12 presets: Pride, Aurora, Lava, Candy, Ocean, Glass, Neon, Sunset, Soft Monet, Minimal, Chunky, Dots
- Live preview inside the app

### How it hooks
- Works with the System UI navigation handle and with the launcher's taskbar handle
- The pill view is found at runtime by scanning the window tree, so no class names are hardcoded per ROM
- Falls back to the stock pill if anything fails

### App
- Home page shows module status (active, partial, not detected), diagnostics and the default launcher
- Material 3 theme with system Monet colors or a custom accent, optional pure black
- Floating dock with width, height, opacity, text size and bottom distance options, and hide on scroll
- English (default) and Turkish
- Master hook switch, debug logging, hide launcher icon, restart System UI or launcher (root)
- Backup and restore as JSON, reset options, update check against GitHub releases

### Requirements
- Root with Zygisk
- LSPosed 2.0.1 or newer (libxposed API 101+)
- Scope: System UI, this app, and your launcher

### Known limitations
- The pill cannot be made wider than the stock one yet
- Animations redraw about 25 times per second, which costs a little battery
- No per-app or contextual styles (keyboard, landscape, charging) yet
EOF
git add CHANGELOG.md && git commit -m "Add changelog" && git push
